A subsequent targeted solve replaced a conservative composite dual with an independently checked exact two-score certificate, proving ell(2)>1.42257, and main verified three citations from inspected source pages. Fresh D0.5 passed mathematics and citations but rated the package incremental (4.5<7.4 field); independent D and main audits found no bounded faithful repair. The sharp seven-dimensional connected saddle, exhaustive support, matching calibrated primal and original-record attainment remain open or conditional; no Lean module or formal proof was produced.
tldr: The categorical critical-compliance benchmark has an exact sixteen-cell likelihood and a seven-dimensional Gaussian minimax reduction that retains unknown first-stage strength. Explicit information profiles and a same-mean composite witness give rigorous confidence-length lower certificates; a new coverage-mixture perturbation strictly improves the closest-path certificate. Two-way Gaussianization and public coverage repair prove uniform original-record value transfer and an all-procedure converse. The evaluated sharp connected-interval saddle and its attaining Gaussian rule remain unresolved.
gap: Regular CRESTE calibration and weak-regularity theory do not evaluate honest confidence length for a nonlinear causal tail contrast at unknown critical compliance. Published minimax confidence-set machinery leaves connected endpoints and composite tail fibers coupled.
